visibleTestCases.title: Parse PING and SET Commands
visibleTestCases.erlangCall: begin {ok, P1} = tcp_kv_backend:parse_command(<<"PING">>), {ok, P2} = tcp_kv_backend:parse_command(<<"SET session_token secret123">>), {P1, P2} end
visibleTestCases.explanation: Parses valid PING and SET command strings into internal representation.

visibleTestCases.title: Execute Wire Commands Against ETS Store
visibleTestCases.erlangCall: begin Tab = ets:new(test_tab, [set, public]), R1 = tcp_kv_backend:execute_command({set, <<"k1">>, <<"val1">>}, Tab), R2 = tcp_kv_backend:execute_command({get, <<"k1">>}, Tab), R3 = tcp_kv_backend:execute_command({del, <<"k1">>}, Tab), R4 = tcp_kv_backend:execute_command({get, <<"k1">>}, Tab), ets:delete(Tab), {R1, R2, R3, R4} end
visibleTestCases.explanation: Validates +OK, $Val, :1, and $-1 return values across SET, GET, and DEL lifecycle.
